Enhances your <arc/>Flashbang, Lightning, Pulse, and Storm Grenade Abilities:

• <arc/>Flashbang Grenade releases a full damage <arc/>Blinding pulse in a 5 meter radius of its first impact with a surface
• <arc/>Lightning Grenade grants an additional Grenade Ability charge. Each pulse <arc/>Jolts targets and grants x5 <arc/>Bolt Charge
• <arc/>Pulse Grenade creates an <arc/>Ionic Trace on hit (1 second cooldown), and deals 2%|9%|18.5%|24%|25% increased damage on the 1|2|3|4|5th pulse. Deals 25% increased damage on all pulses after the 5th
• <arc/>Storm Grenade turns into a roaming 'Storm Cloud' that lasts 4.5 seconds and fires 11 lightning bolts over its lifetime (6 seconds and 15 bolts with <arc/>Spark of Amplitude). Storm Cloud moves at a starting rate of <pve 2.7 /> <pvp [1.5] /> meters per second, then doubles its speed over 1.6? seconds
